name: Li-ion Cell Functional Additives: Acetylene Black & Electrolyte Additives (ECMS)
scope: Conductive acetylene black and battery-grade electrolyte additives (small-volume, high-value cell inputs that India imports almost entirely) got their first domestic ECMS approvals on 17-18 Aug 2026 (PCBL Chemical Rs 329 cr acetylene black; Acutaas Chemicals Rs 256 cr electrolyte additives), but only two listed names are confirmed so far; PCBL has not re-rated (about Rs 313 in mid-Oct vs a 52-week high of about Rs 425-437) while Acutaas is already up roughly 90% in six months (not clearly driven by this theme); it sits next to the existing cell-materials (separator/anode/electrolyte/binder) theme, so treat it as a narrow additive sub-leg, not a broad new theme.
questions: What exactly are acetylene black and electrolyte additives (VC, FEC and similar), what role does each play in a Li-ion cell, and how large is the global market and its growth (IndexBox, Mordor, MarketsandMarkets or similar)?
How import-dependent is India for these inputs today (China share, landed-cost gap), and what does cell demand from ACC/gigafactory and BESS build-outs imply for volumes?

What did the 17-18 Aug 2026 ECMS approvals actually grant PCBL Chemical and Acutaas Chemicals (investment, 25% capex support, capacity, product, timeline), and what do their NSE/BSE filings and investor presentations say?
What is PCBL's technology-transfer arrangement with Ningxia Jinhua for acetylene black, what is the pilot/commercial plant status at Palej, and has any cell maker qualified or contracted the product?

What is Acutaas's electrolyte-additive capability (products, Jhagadia capacity, customer qualification, non-Chinese positioning) and how much of the group's revenue could this become versus its pharma/CDMO base?

Are there other Indian listed companies working on or announcing conductive additives or electrolyte additives (e.g. carbon black makers, fluorochemical and specialty chemical firms)? Check small, mid and large caps and confirm each with a cited company statement; exclude unlisted names such as Epsilon.
How do these additives overlap with the already-covered Li-ion separator and cell-materials theme (Himadri, Gujarat Fluorochem, Graphite India, TCPL), and which names are genuinely incremental?

Has the market priced it in? Give share-price performance over 3, 6 and 12 months for each name (PCBL near-flat/below highs, Acutaas up about 90% in six months), what drove it, and whether broker or media pieces group these stocks under this theme.

What are the risks: Chinese price competition, slow cell-maker qualification, small revenue relative to group size, ECMS disbursement and timeline slippage, thin listed universe, and technology-transfer dependence?
What near-term catalysts exist: plant commissioning dates, cell-maker qualification or offtake announcements, further ECMS tranches, any anti-dumping or duty action, and Q2/Q3 FY27 commentary?

conductive_carbon: Listed carbon-materials makers building conductive additives for cathode and anode electrodes
electrolyte_additives: Listed specialty-chemical makers producing battery-grade electrolyte additives such as VC and FEC
